description: all locations are stored in a graph structure, each have an unique description. both the graph and the descriptions are stored in this file.

edge_1.description: A broad urban road lined with apartment blocks, bus stops, and rows of street trees, connecting the dormitory area to the university campus within a short commute.

edge_2.description: A convenient town route passing cafés, stationery shops, and residential intersections, linking the university's main gate with the nearby supermarket.

edge_3.description: A practical daily path through the modern town center, allowing students and residents to walk or cycle quickly between the dormitory and the supermarket.

dormitory.description: A modern student dormitory complex in the middle of a well-developed town, with mid-rise residential buildings, shared laundry rooms, secure entry gates, vending machines, and a small courtyard where students gather in the evening.

university.description: A comprehensive urban university campus with teaching buildings, libraries, sports grounds, landscaped walkways, and a busy main gate opening directly onto the surrounding town's commercial streets.

supermarket.description: A bright medium-sized supermarket serving the neighborhood, featuring fresh produce, daily necessities, ready-to-eat meals, self-checkout counters, and a small underground parking area for local residents.
